licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Meydan Free Zone, renewal window (unknown from an official source. Not a rule, REPORTED only: consultancies say Meydan sends a reminder 30 days before expiry; a 90 day advance notification is reported for Virtual Asset licences only); https://www.meydanfz.ae/blog/dubai-trade-license-renewal-guide

licence.renewsTogether.value: No Ejari or NOC is needed at renewal; Meydan handles the lease internally. Visa allocations can be renewed or added, and activities changed, during licence renewal. The visa allocation fee runs for one year alongside the business licence expiry. Establishment or immigration card renewal timing: unknown.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Meydan Free Zone, renews together (meydanfz.ae blog and Terms and Conditions, CONFIRMED); https://www.meydanfz.ae/blog/dubai-trade-license-renewal-guide ; https://www.meydanfz.ae/terms-conditions

licence.afterExpiry.value: A 30 day grace period after expiry, with penalties still applying. Long delays can lead to licence cancellation or blacklisting. On non-renewal the Free Zone may cancel all linked services, including immigration cards, employment contracts and visas. All services and licences may be suspended for overdue invoices. No official day threshold for cancellation found.
